title: Guanciale Tacos with Oven-Roasted Vegetables
description: A keto twist on traditional tacos, featuring crispy guanciale and oven-roasted vegetables.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange zucchini and red bell pepper slices on the baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and oregano.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook guanciale slices in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy.
Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble tacos by placing roasted vegetables on a shell, topping with crispy guanciale, and serving with sliced avocado, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.
